pitch.headline: Transforming complex, data-dense healthcare operations into legible, automated, and trustworthy product experiences.
pitch.subheadline: I bring over 12 years of enterprise systems thinking and hands-on engineering collaboration to design Medallion's high-volume provider operation platforms.

painPoints.title: Designing Legible AI, Automation, and Complex Workflows
painPoints.desc: As the founder of a health-tech venture, I architected NLP-driven interfaces that translate semantic inputs into structured data, directly matching Medallion's need to make automated routing, exception handling, and decision support transparent and trustworthy for operational teams.

painPoints.title: Bridging Design Intent with Deep Technical Fluency
painPoints.desc: I run an AI-first prototyping workflow daily using Cursor and Copilot to design data-dense platforms at Allied Solutions, allowing me to reason through system architecture, workflow logic, and engineering constraints to ship production-ready experiences.
